items.title: Fidelity International flags four funds in annual Assessment of Value
items.summary: Fidelity International identified four portfolios that failed to provide value out of 71 evaluated funds.

items.title: KPMG agrees to $224.5m settlement in SVB collapse class action
items.summary: Norges Bank Investment Management and Sjunde AP-fonden have reached a settlement in principle of $224.5 million with KPMG following the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank.

items.title: SiriusPoint chief advises brokers to evaluate carrier commitment alongside ratings when backing MGAs
items.summary: Brokers placing business through managing general agents should examine carrier commitment and relationship length alongside financial ratings, according to SiriusPoint CEO Scott Egan.

items.title: The Guardian launches callout on climate-related risk management in insurance
items.summary: The Guardian has invited insurance industry workers to share how their companies manage climate-related risks amid reports of pressure to downplay natural disaster losses.

items.title: Berkeley Earth confirms 2026 as record hot year as insurers grapple with widening protection gap
items.summary: Berkeley Earth has reported that 2026 is on track to be the hottest year in recorded history, compounding underwriting pressures as insured catastrophe losses rise 5% to 7% annually.

items.title: Global heat records and El Niño place mounting pressure on property insurability
items.summary: Scientists confirm 2026 is on track to be the hottest year on record as climate losses and shrinking carrier appetite reshape property markets.
